name: Liselotta von Kirschbaum
original_name: リーゼロッタ・フォン・キルシュバウム
source:
Class: 1-B
Favorite food: Baumkuchen
Hobbies: Fortune telling, planting and growing herbs (and giving them names as well)
Troubles: Her growth spurt hasn't started yet.

A very shy girl whose only friend is the ferret on top of her head. She is refined thanks to her background as a member of a noble family. Reacts very negatively and immaturely towards the word "small". She hasn't had her first period yet.
